description: Comprehensive evaluation suite for NextBillion MCP tools: 2 representative test cases for each of the 16 registered tools (32 cases total).

cases.title: Autocomplete Google Amphitheatre address prefix
cases.name: autocomplete
cases.description: Strict address prefix completion for Mountain View headquarters
cases.prompt: I am typing 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy into the search bar. Show autocomplete candidates for the prefix '1600 Amphitheatre Pkw'.
cases.passCriteria: Calls autocomplete with query matching prefix

cases.title: Autocomplete 'stat' prefix in Oklahoma City with country filter
cases.name: autocomplete
cases.description: Prefix completion for 'stat' biased around Oklahoma City coordinates from docs.nextbillion.ai
cases.prompt: Complete the partial address prefix 'stat' near latitude 35.4769, longitude -97.4872 restricted to country USA.
cases.passCriteria: Calls autocomplete with query 'stat' and near coordinates

cases.title: Autosuggest misspelled aquarium query
cases.name: autosuggest
cases.description: Typo-tolerant suggestions for search-as-you-type near Boston coordinates

cases.passCriteria: Calls autosuggest with typo query and near coordinates

cases.title: Autosuggest partial tourist query with radius

cases.passCriteria: Calls autosuggest with query 'London muse' and radius

cases.title: Search coffee shops near location

cases.description: Free-text POI and business search around location with radius

cases.passCriteria: Calls place_search with query 'coffee', near coordinates, and radius

cases.title: Search business by name around coordinates

cases.title: Geocode 10 Downing Street address

cases.title: Batch geocode US landmarks
cases.name: geocode_batch

cases.title: Batch geocode White House and Empire State Building
cases.name: geocode_batch

queries.query: Empire State Building, 350 5th Ave, New York, NY
